snippet.title: MONOMOON - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
In MONOMOON, the way forward is reserved for the knowing and the daring. Guided by moonlight, you’ll uncover hidden truths and wander through a tiny and mysterious open world. With no proper instructions, you must deduce and achieve your goals as you solve puzzles, find mysterious items, and uncover secrets hiding right under your nose.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3285880/MONOMOON/

Meet the Dev (Gentle Giant)
Website: https://www.gentlegiantgames.com/
X: https://x.com/gentlegiantgms

#indiegame #puzzleplatformer
